description: Using Unsupervised Learning to Profile Public Service Accessibility based on the Public Transport Infrastructure is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Miguel Nunez-del-Prado. This dataset contains the GPS coordinates for different public transportation routes in Cusco city, Peru. The dataset was collected in collaboration with the Peruvian company "Smart Innovation Group S.R.L." through their solution Smartbus. Coverage: national (PE); the metadata date the deposit to 2022. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support multi-sector infrastructure risk and planning studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
